result.answer: Today the demo bed-management system is set to keep only where the patient is now. If it had to keep every movement in its history, this case would have gone to a person instead of closing with nothing sent (W1). That is the only outcome Shutter can state. Fixing the history would mean cancelling the applied move to WARD-C (08:45 UTC) and replaying the WARD-B move (08:20 UTC), then the WARD-C move, in order. Shutter does not say what the bed board, pharmacy, porters or patient record would do during that replay. They are not visible from the integration engine. The dependency notes say pharmacy is told about every location change and porters get a task for every applied transfer. So a cancel and replay could, by inference, trigger extra redirections and porter tasks for a patient who is already on WARD-C. Under the current setting, doing nothing leaves the record correct at WARD-C, bed BAY1-07, and the systems that read it follow that. A plain resend of the WARD-B move would be worse. It would move the patient back to a ward they have left. I cannot change this setting or act on the case.

response.content: I've submitted my answer: with a full-history setting, this case would have gone to a person instead of closing, and the effect on the bed board, pharmacy, porters and patient record can only be inferred, because Shutter can't see those systems.
